verdict.rationale: Bruno stores all collections as plain-text .bru files directly on the local filesystem (open, human-readable format) rather than in a proprietary cloud DB, with no account/login required, so users inherently 'own' and can freely move/export their data by copying the folder; Git-native versioning and Postman import/export further reinforce open, portable data. Community confirms 'collections are plain text files in Git' and offline-first design.
